trial.program_source:
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    candidates=[]
    for color in set(sum(grid,[]))-{0}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        a,b=min(r for r,c in pts),max(r for r,c in pts)
        x,y=min(c for r,c in pts),max(c for r,c in pts)
        if b>a and y>x:
            border=[(r,c) for r in range(a,b+1) for c in range(x,y+1) if r in (a,b) or c in (x,y)]
            score=sum(grid[r][c]==color for r,c in border)/len(border)
            candidates.append((score,color,a,b,x,y))
    _,color,a,b,x,y=max(candidates)
    return [[color if grid[r][c]==color else 0 for c in range(x,y+1)] for r in range(a,b+1)]
